SC_DRAFT_ITEM_INCLUDED.remediation: Publish the item in its key-user app (Custom Fields / Custom Logic / Custom CDS Views) before export; draft items are not transported.
SC_DRAFT_ITEM_INCLUDED.title: Unpublished (draft) item in collection

SC_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.remediation: Supply every input the engine's contract marks as required (see the engine catalog entry). No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Software Collection Dependency Guard (JSON, XML, ZIP) and re-run the analysis.
SC_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.title: Required input missing

SC_INVALID_INPUT.remediation: Provide the artifact type documented for this engine; unrelated or structurally invalid documents are rejected. No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Software Collection Dependency Guard (JSON, XML, ZIP) and re-run the analysis.
SC_INVALID_INPUT.title: Artifact does not match the engine input contract

SC_MISSING_PREREQUISITE.remediation: Add the prerequisite collection to the export, or import it into the target tenant first ('Import Collection'), then re-run the preflight.
SC_MISSING_PREREQUISITE.title: Prerequisite collection neither exported nor in target

SC_PARSE_ERROR.remediation: Fix the syntax error at the reported line/column (or re-export the file unmodified from SAP). No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Software Collection Dependency Guard (JSON, XML, ZIP) and re-run the analysis.
SC_PARSE_ERROR.title: Artifact could not be parsed

SC_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.remediation: Split the export (e.g. per package, company code or date range) so each upload stays under the service payload limit. No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Software Collection Dependency Guard (JSON, XML, ZIP) and re-run the analysis.
SC_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Artifact exceeds the size limit

SC_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.remediation: Re-export the software collection from 'Export Software Collection'; the named collection/item entry is missing mandatory attributes (id, type, status) and was excluded from the dependency analysis.
SC_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Collection or item entry violates the export schema

SPRO_ARCHIVE_REJECTED.remediation: The archive exceeded the 100:1 expansion ratio, 500 MB total size, entry-count or 2-level nesting limit, or contained path traversal / encrypted members. Upload a flat, unencrypted archive of the export files. No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by SPRO2Cloud (CSV, JSON, TEXT) and re-run the analysis.
SPRO_ARCHIVE_REJECTED.title: Archive rejected by ingestion safety limits

SPRO_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.remediation: Supply every input the engine's contract marks as required (see the engine catalog entry). No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by SPRO2Cloud (CSV, JSON, TEXT) and re-run the analysis.
SPRO_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.title: Required input missing

SPRO_INVALID_INPUT.remediation: Provide the artifact type documented for this engine; unrelated or structurally invalid documents are rejected. No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by SPRO2Cloud (CSV, JSON, TEXT) and re-run the analysis.
SPRO_INVALID_INPUT.title: Artifact does not match the engine input contract

SPRO_MAPPING_EXACT.remediation: Re-create the setting in the target tenant via the mapped SSCUI in 'Manage Your Solution' > Configure Your Solution, under the listed scope item; no redesign required.
SPRO_MAPPING_EXACT.title: IMG activity has an exact cloud SSCUI equivalent

SPRO_MAPPING_NEEDS_REVIEW.remediation: The activity is not in the curated SPRO→SSCUI catalog snapshot. Assess it manually; custom Z/Y tables can be rebuilt as Custom Business Objects or ABAP Cloud tables with a maintenance app.
SPRO_MAPPING_NEEDS_REVIEW.title: Uncataloged / custom configuration needs manual review

SPRO_MAPPING_NOT_AVAILABLE.remediation: Treat as a cloud parity gap: adopt the standard process, move the requirement to a side-by-side extension on SAP BTP, or reconsider the Private Edition.
SPRO_MAPPING_NOT_AVAILABLE.title: IMG activity not available in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition

SPRO_MAPPING_PARTIAL.remediation: Use the mapped SSCUI for the supported parameters; re-implement the restricted sub-parameters with key-user extensibility or document them as a fit-to-standard deviation.
SPRO_MAPPING_PARTIAL.title: IMG activity only partially available in cloud

SPRO_MAPPING_PROCESS_REDESIGN.remediation: Redesign the process on the cloud successor concept named in the finding (e.g. Output Management instead of NACE); plan it as a migration work package with business sign-off.
SPRO_MAPPING_PROCESS_REDESIGN.title: Legacy configuration concept requires process redesign

SPRO_MAPPING_SCOPE_DEPENDENT.remediation: Activate the listed scope items in Central Business Configuration before configuring the SSCUI; check licensing for the scope item.
SPRO_MAPPING_SCOPE_DEPENDENT.title: Cloud setting requires scope item activation

SPRO_PARSE_ERROR.remediation: Fix the syntax error at the reported line/column (or re-export the file unmodified from SAP). No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by SPRO2Cloud (CSV, JSON, TEXT) and re-run the analysis.
SPRO_PARSE_ERROR.title: Artifact could not be parsed

SPRO_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.remediation: Split the export (e.g. per package, company code or date range) so each upload stays under the service payload limit. No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by SPRO2Cloud (CSV, JSON, TEXT) and re-run the analysis.
SPRO_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Artifact exceeds the size limit

TR_ARCHIVE_REJECTED.remediation: The archive exceeded the 100:1 expansion ratio, 500 MB total size, entry-count or 2-level nesting limit, or contained path traversal / encrypted members. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Transport Dependency Analyzer (JSON, CSV, XML) and re-run the analysis.
TR_ARCHIVE_REJECTED.title: Archive rejected by ingestion safety limits

TR_CALL_DEPENDENCY_SEQUENCE_RISK.remediation: Import the transport containing the referenced object first (adjust the STMS import queue / planned sequence) or bundle caller and callee in one transport of copies.
TR_CALL_DEPENDENCY_SEQUENCE_RISK.title: Caller imported before the object it references

TR_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED.remediation: Merge the mutually dependent requests into one transport of copies; circular requests have no valid import order.
TR_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED.title: Circular dependency between transports

TR_CUSTOMIZING_AHEAD_OF_STRUCTURE.remediation: Import the workbench request that creates/changes the table structure before the customizing request carrying its table entries (E071K).
TR_CUSTOMIZING_AHEAD_OF_STRUCTURE.title: Customizing imported before its DDIC structure

TR_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.remediation: Supply every input the engine's contract marks as required (see the engine catalog entry). No verdict was produced. Re-export the artifact in one of the formats accepted by Transport Dependency Analyzer (JSON, CSV, XML) and re-run the analysis.
TR_INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.title: Required input missing

TR_INVALID_INPUT.title: Artifact does not match the engine input contract

TR_OBJECT_COLLISION.remediation: Consolidate the object's changes into one transport (or use ChaRM / cross-system object lock, CSOL); otherwise the later import silently overwrites the earlier version.
TR_OBJECT_COLLISION.title: Object locked in multiple concurrent transports

TR_OVERTAKER_DOWNGRADE_RISK.remediation: Do not import the older transport after the newer one (overtaker); re-sequence the queue or remove the object from the older request.
TR_OVERTAKER_DOWNGRADE_RISK.title: Older object version overtakes a newer one

WF_ARCHIVE_REJECTED.title: Archive rejected by ingestion safety limits

WF_BACKGROUND_TASK_FAILED.remediation: Analyse the exception in SWI1 / SWWLOGHIST, correct the data or method, then restart the item via SWPR / SWIA 'Restart after error'.
WF_BACKGROUND_TASK_FAILED.title: Background step ended in error

WF_CONTAINER_BINDING_ERROR.remediation: Fix the binding in the workflow builder (SWDD) or the task container; correct the instance data and restart the item.
WF_CONTAINER_BINDING_ERROR.title: Container element empty or binding failed

WF_DEADLINE_BREACHED.remediation: Escalate per the deadline configuration, forward to a substitute and review the deadline job (SWWDHEX / SWWDEADL).
WF_DEADLINE_BREACHED.title: Deadline / SLA exceeded

WF_DEADLOCK_DETECTED.remediation: Break the wait cycle: complete or logically delete one item (SWIA) and redesign the conditions / fork so the steps do not wait on each other.
WF_DEADLOCK_DETECTED.title: Circular wait between work items

WF_EVENT_LINKAGE_DEACTIVATED.remediation: Reactivate the linkage in SWE2 (and check why it was deactivated — error feedback 'deactivate linkage').
WF_EVENT_LINKAGE_DEACTIVATED.title: Event type linkage deactivated

WF_STUCK_NO_AGENT.title: Work item READY without any possible agent
